panels.title: Dedupe jobs
panels.description: One row per tape in a deduplication queue. 'First seen' is when the collector first saw the job (the API has no start time; accurate to one collector interval). 'drive' is the drive the tape is being read from.

panels.title: Replication jobs
panels.description: queue=dedupe: the replication leg of a deduplication job (outgoing, from the source). classic: a non-deduplicated tape (outgoing). unique: the unique-data phase as seen on the target (incoming, with the appliance's own start time). Replication uses no tape drive.

options.content: Repository maintenance (space reclamation and index pruning)

panels.title: Reclamation and pruning running now
panels.description: Only jobs with status 'running' are listed; the table is empty when no reclamation or prune is in progress. 'Running since' is when the collector first saw the run (the API gives only idle/running/failed, no start time or space figures).

panels.title: Latest policy run per appliance
panels.description: Ratio, scanned, unique and duration are from the most recent completed run; status and trigger are from the most recent run of any status.
